# Step-less capture recipes give way to their examples' landing frames

Owned and dated: the operator's PRIO 0 of 22 Nov, before the Engine 14 cut. It follows #21903 / PR #21908, so no contributor labels.

## Context

The operator, 22 Nov ~11:35Z, on the capture recipes in the examples' data: "BLOAT for all example definitions with fixed sizes and CSS selectors in json configs? this is NOT neo best practices … PRIO 0." The recipes are frozen (#21903), and PR #21908 captures a covered card without a recipe from the frame a visitor lands on (Clio's rule on #21140: a cover is that frame).

## The Problem

30 of the 82 recipes in `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json` script no step. Each still carries a viewport, `ready`/`after` selectors and a crop region for a state its example already shows on landing. `gantt-basic`, for example: a 1280×720 viewport, two `ready` and six `after` selectors, and a 640×360 crop at the timeline header. With #21908 merged, each becomes a landing capture the moment its recipe goes.

## The Architectural Reality

- `validateCaptureRecipes` and `capture` (`buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`): a covered card without a recipe gets a landing entry (960×540 at device scale 1⅓, `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark`, `landingReady`, a dark theme shown, at most 150,000 bytes).
- Deleting a recipe changes no published cover: covers live on `neomjs/pages` until a capture replaces them.
- Pre-screen at #21908's head `209957af79`, each record opened exactly as a landing capture opens it, nothing written to the repository: 22 of the 30 pass. Eight fail:
  - `markdown`, `list-animate`, `graph-scene`, `am-charts` open on Neo Light (#21975 owns their wiring);
  - `gallery` and `helix` never hold still;
  - `on-air-at-eight` and `dock-choreography` do not reach network idle within 15 s.

## The Fix

Delete the recipe of every step-less record whose landing capture passes at the PR's head. Keep the others, each with its failure named in the PR, for its example's own leaf.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Every deleted recipe's record captures from its landing frame with `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --record <id>` at the PR's head (receipt: one report row per record).
- [ ] AC-2: Every step-less recipe left names its failure in the PR body.
- [ ] AC-3: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` passes against the committed manifest and catalog.

## Out of Scope

The 52 stepped recipes (each example lands on its state in its own code: one leaf per example); recapturing or publishing covers (#21933's paired pass); deleting the manifest.
